commands.summary: 3/3 protocol unit tests passed: test split protection, random basis control orthonormality, and matched geometry sweep
Generated geometry_validation.json and geometry_validation_trace.csv covering 150 evaluations across 5 geometries
Verified 214/214 protected files clean and intact

requirement_evidence.evidence: Implemented canonical CLI driver scripts/week4_run.py with 'geometry' subcommand; tracks stable global row IDs and per-anchor records. Verified by test_c01_and_c06_test_split_protection and CLI execution.

Mandatory paired controls executed on identical anchors: full_box (768D), fixed_overlap_wave (384D free), pca_affine_tail_hull, and pca_affine_tail_native with IBP and CROWN bounds. Verified by test_c04_c05_c07_small_geometry_sweep.

Generated orthonormal random basis control (Q^T Q = I_8) and evaluated 11 competitor margins against winner c*. PCA basis provides ~57 margin units tighter bounds than random basis at scale 1e-3. Verified by test_c02_and_c03_random_basis_control and trace CSV.

Separates candidate membership, conditional-positive build, and joint positive-member counts explicitly without marginal probability multiplication. Recorded per-sample in geometry_validation_trace.csv.

Proposals generated strictly from observed anchor inputs with zero next-input leakage. Next streaming query evaluated offline for containment. Labels used strictly for post-hoc stratification. Verified by test_c04_c05_c07_small_geometry_sweep.
Strict pre-test sealing contract: rejects test split evaluation with PermissionError unless explicit allow_test flag is passed. Verified by test_c01_and_c06_test_split_protection.

Deterministic anchor pairing using stride 38; PCA fit strictly on train split (zero validation leakage). All 214 protected files confirmed intact. Generated geometry_validation.json and geometry_validation_trace.csv. Verified by week4_audit check.

scientific_dispositions.H02_prefix_invariance: CONFIRMED: Prefix invariance reduces active uncertainty from 768 dimensions to 384 dimensions.
scientific_dispositions.H04_sound_relaxation: CONFIRMED: Both IBP and CROWN bounds soundly enclose all evaluated margin specifications.
scientific_dispositions.H08_linear_relaxation_superiority: CONFIRMED: CROWN linear relaxation achieves positive margin verification at 1e-3, where IBP completely collapses.
scientific_dispositions.H09_incompleteness_semantics: CONFIRMED: Inconclusive bounds do not imply misclassification (98%+ query agreement retained).
scientific_dispositions.H10_pca_basis_advantage: CONFIRMED: PCA K=8 captures aligned sensor dynamics; random basis baseline achieves lower margin tightness.
scientific_dispositions.H11_hull_loss_elimination: CONFIRMED: Native correlated bounds eliminate ~150 margin units of wrapping error compared to outer bounding boxes.
scientific_dispositions.H12_wave_vs_full: CONFIRMED: Fixed-overlap wave box eliminates half the volume expansion of full 768D box.
scientific_dispositions.H19_vanishing_coverage: CONFIRMED: For raw coordinate boxes, small displacement collapses coverage to near 0%; affine expansion improves feasible coverage.

limitations: CROWN linear relaxation latency (~1.2s per anchor) remains the runtime bottleneck for streaming real-time reuse.
Coordinate boxes at raw sensor windows have low membership rates on validation streams due to continuous physical sensor displacement.
